licence.scope: No owner statement found and no paper in info.json. The TD-1 S2/68 ultraviolet experiment was an ESRO satellite payload (Humphries et al. 1976, A&A 49, 389, is the calibration paper); the HEASARC TD1 catalogue page serves the catalogue, not these curves, and carries no terms for them, and aanda.org returns 403 to curl. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
